T: All work and no play. So, dinner.
D: A writer takes a winter job as caretaker of an empty mountain hotel with his wife and son.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack sits down at the Gold Room bar.
S: Hallorann's tour of the giant pantry
Crackers, tinned fruit and big jars of olives and pickles laid out like the hotel stores, a wedge of cheddar for good measure.
the maze outside, under the snow
Herb crackers cut into a square, scored with a maze pattern, rosemary and parsley pressed in, baked at 180C until crisp.

Warm mixed nuts roasted with butter, brown sugar, rosemary and a pinch of cayenne. Toss 400g mixed unsalted nuts with 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tsp salt flakes and a pinch of cayenne.
M: the walk-in freezer tour, Dick knows every shelf
Leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink with potatoes and gravy. Stud a 2kg leg of lamb with 4 sliced garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs, rub with oil, salt and pepper.
the tray she takes up to Jack
Soft scrambled eggs cooked slowly in butter, crisp bacon, buttered toast and orange juice on a tray.
W: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
Cream and milk warmed with dark chocolate and cocoa, whisked into yolks and sugar, cooked to 82C, chilled and churned.
K: Jack's order from Lloyd at the Gold Room
60ml bourbon over a large block of ice in a heavy tumbler.

s.note: Hallorann's tour of the giant pantry
s.how: Lay out crackers, a big jar of dill pickles, a bowl of olives and a drained tin of peaches on a board like the hotel storeroom. Add a 250g wedge of cheddar for good measure.

Toss 400g mixed unsalted nuts with 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tsp salt flakes and a pinch of cayenne. Roast at 180C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, and serve warm.

m.note: the walk-in freezer tour, Dick knows every shelf
m.how: Stud a 2kg leg of lamb with 4 sliced garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs, rub with oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 20 minutes with 1kg quartered potatoes around it. Rest 15 minutes and make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.

w.note: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with 150g dark chocolate and 2 tbsp cocoa. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook, stirring, to 82C. Chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Jack's order from Lloyd at the Gold Room
d.how: Put a large block of ice in each of four heavy tumblers. Pour 60ml bourbon over each. Sip slowly at the bar, and don't trust the bartender.
